text: The Pacific Catastrophe Risk Assessment and Financing Initiative (PCRAFI) is a multi-partner initiative aimed at improving the fiscal resilience of Pacific Island Countries, including Papua New Guinea, against natural disasters. It combines risk information and analytics, financial solutions, and institutional capacity building to address risks from tropical cyclones, earthquakes, and tsunamis. The initiative provides sovereign insurance and risk financing through the Pacific Catastrophe Risk Insurance Company (PCRIC) and the Pacific Catastrophe Risk Insurance Foundation (PCRIF).
